models.notes: Short-range BlazeFace: faces within ~2 m, i.e. selfies. Identical bytes to the face_detector.tflite inside face_landmarker.task, so this is also the detector MediaPipe FaceLandmarker uses. ROI warp (MediaPipe ImageToTensor, OpenCV CPU path): take the rotated ROI rectangle in source pixels (center, width, height, rotation in radians, clockwise-positive in image coordinates since y points down); corners = cv::boxPoints order [bottom-left, top-left, top-right, bottom-right]; map them to tensor corners [(0,H),(0,0),(W,0),(W,H)] with a perspective (here affine) transform, i.e. corner-to-corner, not pixel-centre; sample the uint8 RGB source with bilinear interpolation (cv::warpPerspective, INTER_LINEAR) at integer tensor pixel coordinates; THEN normalise. Out-of-image pixels follow the border mode stated per model. keep_aspect_ratio=true: before the warp, the ROI is enlarged (never cropped) to the tensor aspect ratio, padding equally on both sides (PadRoi); padding fractions are needed to map outputs back. Border mode: BORDER_ZERO (black, which becomes -1.0 after normalisation). ROI = whole image, rotation 0. Anchors: num_layers 4, strides [8,16,16,16], input 128x128, min_scale 0.1484375, max_scale 0.75, anchor_offset 0.5/0.5, aspect_ratios [1.0], interpolated_scale_aspect_ratio 1.0, fixed_anchor_size true -> 16x16x2 + 8x8x6 = 896 anchors. Anchor generation (SsdAnchorsCalculator): for each layer l with stride s: feature map F = ceil(input/s); for y in 0..F, x in 0..F, emit anchors_per_cell anchors at center ((x+anchor_offset_x)/F, (y+anchor_offset_y)/F), w=h=1 (fixed_anchor_size). Consecutive layers with the same stride are merged into one feature map whose anchors_per_cell is the sum: with aspect_ratios=[1.0] and interpolated_scale_aspect_ratio=1.0 each layer contributes 2 anchors per cell, with interpolated_scale_aspect_ratio=0.0 it contributes 1. Order: layer group, then y, then x, then anchor index within the cell. Decoding (TensorsToDetectionsCalculator): regressors[0,i,:] = [dx, dy, w, h, kp0x, kp0y, ... kp5x, kp5y] (reverse_output_order=true, so x before y). With anchor (ax, ay) in [0,1] and scale S = input size: cx = ax + dx/S, cy = ay + dy/S, w = w/S, h = h/S (fixed_anchor_size: anchor w=h=1); keypoint k = (ax + kx/S, ay + ky/S). Score = sigmoid(clamp(classificators[0,i,0], -100, 100)); keep score >= min_score_thresh. Then NMS: algorithm WEIGHTED, overlap IoU, min_suppression_threshold 0.3 (Tasks default FaceDetectorOptions.min_suppression_threshold). Coordinates are normalised to the letterboxed tensor; remove the letterbox padding to get image-normalised values. Keypoints (subject = the person): 0 right eye (image-left), 1 left eye (image-right), 2 nose tip, 3 mouth centre, 4 right ear tragion, 5 left ear tragion. Scale S = 128. MediaPipe min_score_thresh default 0.5. Landmark ROI from a detection (FaceDetectorGraph -> FaceLandmarker): rect = detection box in image pixels; rotation = 0 - atan2(-(kp1.y - kp0.y), kp1.x - kp0.x) using pixel coordinates (DetectionsToRects, start keypoint 0, end keypoint 1, target angle 0), normalised to [-pi, pi]; then scale width and height by 1.5 around the centre (RectTransformation, square_long false). Precision: weights stored as fp16 (as upstream) and Cast to float32 inside the graph; all computation and every graph input/output is float32.
